requirements.title: Milestone boundary and invariant
requirements.summary: Optional specialties and external provider integrations. Synthetic-only implementation; retain doctor ownership, independent secretary grants and separate patient identity/relationship/encounter; no clinical/legal/provider/commercial authority inferred.
requirements.provenance: Supplied roadmap v0.2 plus current delegated scope.

requirements.title: Specialty prioritization and clinician-led templates
requirements.summary: Select specialty modules through approved clinical requirements rather than assuming one universal chart. Acceptance: Obtain explicit owner selection of optional specialties and provider connectors; all eight named tasks remain stored without implying that every connector will be implemented. For selected specialties, obtain clinician-led versioned fields/workflows and review boundaries; no universal template or specialty competence is assumed. Record chosen scope, deferred tasks, qualified reviewers and acceptance fixtures without renumbering stable task IDs or cancelling history. Prepare evidence for DOS-M9-GATE-OPTIONAL. Stop before any provider/native/live-data dependent implementation until the accountable reviewer approves the relevant decision; producing this packet does not grant approval.
requirements.provenance: Detailed decomposition of DOS-M9-001 from supplied roadmap; ordinary design choices, evidence-gated domain decisions.

requirements.title: Egypt medication catalogue / national prescription feasibility
requirements.summary: Verify source licensing, interfaces and access terms before implementing an EDA/national adapter. Acceptance: Verify actual medication catalogue/national prescription source, licensing, redistribution, version/update and access terms using provider evidence. Record whether an EDA/national interface exists and is accessible to this entity; unavailable access yields a feasibility finding, never a fabricated adapter. Specify approved fallback/manual-entry behavior and preserve M2 clinician review/signing authority; no automatic substitution or dosing recommendation. Prepare evidence for DOS-M9-GATE-MEDICATION. Stop before any provider/native/live-data dependent implementation until the accountable reviewer approves the relevant decision; producing this packet does not grant approval.
requirements.provenance: Detailed decomposition of DOS-M9-002 from supplied roadmap; ordinary design choices, evidence-gated domain decisions.

requirements.title: Lab integration
requirements.summary: Implement one verified partner protocol with identity matching, provenance and retry/reconciliation. Acceptance: Select one verified lab partner with documented protocol/version, sandbox access, commercial/data terms and explicit identity-matching rules. Map request/result IDs and provenance to the exact patient relationship/order; ambiguous matches are quarantined for authorized review, never merged by contact. Implement authenticated idempotent delivery/retry/reconciliation with result review/release still clinician-controlled. Prepare evidence for DOS-M9-GATE-LAB. Stop before any provider/native/live-data dependent implementation until the accountable reviewer approves the relevant decision; producing this packet does not grant approval.
requirements.provenance: Detailed decomposition of DOS-M9-003 from supplied roadmap; ordinary design choices, evidence-gated domain decisions.

requirements.title: Imaging/radiology integration
requirements.summary: Implement one approved imaging workflow and data exchange with minimum-necessary access. Acceptance: Approve one imaging workflow and partner exchange contract including identifiers, document/image access, version and minimum-necessary disclosure. Preserve order/patient/doctor provenance, private viewer/document authorization and reconciliation of external status. Do not assume a particular imaging standard, endpoint or diagnostic interpretation before verified partner requirements. Prepare evidence for DOS-M9-GATE-IMAGING. Stop before any provider/native/live-data dependent implementation until the accountable reviewer approves the relevant decision; producing this packet does not grant approval.
requirements.provenance: Detailed decomposition of DOS-M9-004 from supplied roadmap; ordinary design choices, evidence-gated domain decisions.

requirements.title: Pharmacy integration
requirements.summary: Connect approved fulfillment/status flows without assuming medication substitution or dispensing authority. Acceptance: Approve partner/contract, fulfillment fields and permitted prescription release with patient/doctor consent and minimum data. Exchange only authorized signed/current prescription versions and fulfillment/status events with idempotency and provenance. Stopping/amending a prescription reconciles partner state; neither adapter nor pharmacy-status UI may infer medication substitution or prescribing/dispensing authority. Prepare evidence for DOS-M9-GATE-PHARMACY. Stop before any provider/native/live-data dependent implementation until the accountable reviewer approves the relevant decision; producing this packet does not grant approval.
requirements.provenance: Detailed decomposition of DOS-M9-005 from supplied roadmap; ordinary design choices, evidence-gated domain decisions.

requirements.title: Insurance/UHIA feasibility and first connector
requirements.summary: Verify eligibility, standards, contracting and actual API availability before claims integration. Acceptance: Obtain current qualified applicability and contracting review for the named insurer/UHIA route, actual API availability, standards/version and credential eligibility. Define approved eligibility/claim fields, consent, coding responsibilities and financial reconciliation without fabricating coverage or reimbursement. Build the first connector only after verified contract/sandbox evidence; unavailable access is a documented feasibility blocker, not a mock production integration. Prepare evidence for DOS-M9-GATE-INSURANCE. Stop before any provider/native/live-data dependent implementation until the accountable reviewer approves the relevant decision; producing this packet does not grant approval.
requirements.provenance: Detailed decomposition of DOS-M9-006 from supplied roadmap; ordinary design choices, evidence-gated domain decisions.

requirements.title: Interoperable clinical export or referral exchange
requirements.summary: Select required standards/profile/version with partner testing and explicit patient/doctor access policy. Acceptance: Select the actual standard/profile/version and partner contract through explicit decision, with approved minimum clinical dataset and patient/doctor release policy. Map stable identifiers, units, terminology, timestamps, provenance and amendment references; unsupported fields must be reported rather than silently dropped. Validate authorized export/import against partner fixtures with idempotency and quarantine ambiguous identity/version matches; cross-doctor access remains independently granted. Prepare evidence for DOS-M9-GATE-EXCHANGE. Stop before any provider/native/live-data dependent implementation until the accountable reviewer approves the relevant decision; producing this packet does not grant approval.
requirements.provenance: Detailed decomposition of DOS-M9-007 from supplied roadmap; ordinary design choices, evidence-gated domain decisions.

requirements.title: Optional-module acceptance and rollout
requirements.summary: Verify chosen specialty/provider modules independently; telemedicine, AI diagnosis and hospital systems are not silently included. Acceptance: Verify each explicitly selected optional module independently using partner sandbox/contract and qualified specialty review on the exact candidate. Retain deferred/unavailable module IDs and list exclusions; do not claim telemedicine, AI diagnosis, hospital systems or universal provider coverage. Obtain separate rollout authorization per module with incident/recovery and compatibility evidence; this task does not deploy or purchase access.
requirements.provenance: Detailed decomposition of DOS-M9-008 from supplied roadmap; ordinary design choices, evidence-gated domain decisions.

transaction_contract: Verify exact Automation target, live function/schema/trigger fingerprints, immutable project ID, route, model, retry policy, command registrations and publication scopes before writes.

Acquire parent-reviewed transaction serialization lock and reread every scoped ID; existing equal payload is a no-op only after full canonical comparison; any differing state/history aborts. Never overwrite existing tasks, decisions, execution or requirement history.
Create or verify the real OPEN milestone start decision before any task; create every task through supported function and link every task to that decision with blocking=true in the SAME transaction.
Create all requirement, decision and dependency links and refresh contracts after final metadata. Do not commit partial task/link batches.

Assert exact payload counts, complete links, zero ready Doctor tasks using live ready-task predicate, zero claims/runs/executions, no publication authority, and all start decisions still OPEN immediately before commit.
Dry-run rollback and review returned evidence first. Parent controls any commit; never remove a guard from the original draft SQL.
After commit read back canonical packets and zero-ready evidence. Keep all nine start gates open until parent confirms all nine safely saved; release each milestone separately in dependency order.
